story.iWant: a properly configured Vite + React + TypeScript project with all core dependencies
story.soThat: I have a solid foundation for building the application

tasks.task: Create Vite + React + TypeScript project Run npm create vite@latest flowline-finance-studio -- --template react-ts Navigate into project directory Run npm install to install base dependencies Verify npm run dev starts successfully

Configure Tailwind CSS with custom theme Initialize Tailwind CSS via shadcn/ui init or direct install Configure tailwind.config.ts with Balanced Teal theme colors Set primary color to teal-600 (#0d9488) Configure semantic colors (green-500 success, red-500 error, amber-500 warning)

Initialize shadcn/ui components Run npx shadcn@latest init Select TypeScript, Balanced Teal theme, CSS variables Install required components: Button, Card, Input, Form, Table, Toast, Tabs Verify components are accessible in src/components/ui/
Configure path aliases Update tsconfig.json with @/* path mapping to ./src/* Update vite.config.ts with resolve.alias configuration Verify imports work with @/ prefix

Set up ESLint + Prettier Configure ESLint with TypeScript and React rules Install and configure Prettier Create .eslintrc.cjs and .prettierrc configuration files Add lint scripts to package.json Verify npm run lint works

Install core dependencies Install production deps: recharts dexie dexie-react-hooks zustand big.js date-fns react-hook-form zod @hookform/resolvers Install dev deps: @types/big.js vitest @testing-library/react @testing-library/jest-dom Verify all packages in package.json

Configure Vitest for testing Create vite.config.ts test configuration Create tests/setup.ts with Testing Library setup Create placeholder test file that passes Add test script to package.json Verify npm run test passes
Set up folder structure Create folder structure per Architecture doc Create placeholder files to preserve structure
Verify build commands Run npm run dev and verify server starts Run npm run build and verify build completes Run npm run preview and verify production build works

Given the project is initialized When I check code quality tools Then ESLint + Prettier are configured and working

Given the project is ready When I check package.json Then all dependencies from Architecture doc are installed: recharts, dexie, dexie-react-hooks, zustand, big.js, date-fns, react-hook-form, zod, @hookform/resolvers, vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom

Given all dependencies are installed When I run npm run build Then production bundle is generated without errors

doc.snippet: Acceptance criteria for project initialization including Vite setup, Tailwind CSS with teal theme, shadcn/ui components, path aliases, ESLint/Prettier, and all core dependencies.

code.note: This is Story 1.1 - first story in a greenfield project. No existing source code to reference. All code will be created by this story.

ui-framework.name: shadcn/ui
ui-framework.components: Button, Card, Input, Form, Table, Toast, Tabs

constraints.constraint: Client-side only SPA - no backend, no server-side rendering
All data persisted locally via IndexedDB (Dexie.js)
Calculation logic must be framework-agnostic in src/lib/
Files: kebab-case, Components: PascalCase, Hooks: use* prefix, Functions: camelCase
Use @/ path alias for all src/ imports - no deep relative paths
Tailwind utility classes only - no custom CSS files except index.css
Primary color: teal-600 (#0d9488) - Balanced Teal theme from UX spec
All monetary calculations must use big.js - no floating point arithmetic
Vitest with React Testing Library - tests in tests/ directory or *.test.ts colocated

interfaces.note: Story 1.1 establishes the project foundation. No existing interfaces to implement against. This story creates the baseline configuration that all subsequent stories will build upon.

tests.standards: Use Vitest as the test runner with React Testing Library for component testing. Tests should be fast, isolated, and focused on behavior rather than implementation. Test files use *.test.ts or *.test.tsx naming convention. Setup file at tests/setup.ts imports @testing-library/jest-dom matchers for DOM assertions.
